title: How to Speak So That People Want to Listen | Julian Treasure | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】如何說話才能讓人願意聽 |朱利安寶藏 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: The human voice: It's the instrument we all play.
cues.en: The human voice: It's the instrument we all play.
cues.zh: 我們每個人， 都會運用語音。

cues.text: It's the most powerful sound in the world, probably.
cues.en: It's the most powerful sound in the world, probably.
cues.zh: 這大概是全世界最有影響力的聲音， 一句話能夠挑起連天的戰火，

cues.text: It's the only one that can start a war or say "I love you." And yet many people have the experience
cues.en: It's the only one that can start a war or say "I love you." And yet many people have the experience
cues.zh: 一句話能夠挑起連天的戰火， 也能表達愛慕的情愫。 很多人都有相似的經歷： 說了話卻沒人在聽。

cues.text: that when they speak, people don't listen to them.
cues.en: that when they speak, people don't listen to them.
cues.zh: 說了話卻沒人在聽。

cues.text: And why is that?
cues.en: And why is that?
cues.zh: 這是為什麼呢？

cues.text: How can we speak powerfully to make change in the world?
cues.en: How can we speak powerfully to make change in the world?
cues.zh: 如何讓話語擲地有聲， 進而改變世界？

cues.text: What I'd like to suggest, there are a number of habits that we need to move away from.
cues.en: What I'd like to suggest, there are a number of habits that we need to move away from.
cues.zh: 我建議大家， 我們要改掉一些不良習慣。 我整理出講話中的「七宗罪」，

cues.text: I've assembled for your pleasure here seven deadly sins of speaking.
cues.en: I've assembled for your pleasure here seven deadly sins of speaking.
cues.zh: 我整理出講話中的「七宗罪」， 供大家參考。

cues.text: I'm not pretending this is an exhaustive list, but these seven, I think, are pretty large habits that we can all fall into.
cues.en: I'm not pretending this is an exhaustive list, but these seven, I think, are pretty large habits that we can all fall into.
cues.zh: 供大家參考。 內容並非盡善盡美， 但是這七條過失， 可能是我們所有人的弱點。

cues.text: First, gossip.
cues.en: First, gossip.
cues.zh: 可能是我們所有人的弱點。 首先，「說長道短」。

cues.text: Speaking ill of somebody who's not present.
cues.en: Speaking ill of somebody who's not present.
cues.zh: 我們在別人背後指指點點，

cues.text: Not a nice habit, and we know perfectly well the person gossiping, five minutes later, will be gossiping about us.
cues.en: Not a nice habit, and we know perfectly well the person gossiping, five minutes later, will be gossiping about us.
cues.zh: 這是個壞習慣。 如果有人在我們面前搬弄別人的是非， 那麼五分鐘後他就會在別人面前評論我們。

cues.text: Second, judging.
cues.en: Second, judging.
cues.zh: 那麼五分鐘後他就會在別人面前評論我們。 第二，「評斷」。

cues.text: We know people who are like this in conversation, and it's very hard to listen to somebody
cues.en: We know people who are like this in conversation, and it's very hard to listen to somebody
cues.zh: 很多人在交談時都很喜歡評判。 如果別人在說話時批評你， 或認為你能力不足，

cues.text: if you know that you're being judged and found wanting at the same time.
cues.en: if you know that you're being judged and found wanting at the same time.
cues.zh: 或認為你能力不足， 你就不會願意聽他講話。

cues.text: Third, negativity.
cues.en: Third, negativity.
cues.zh: 第三，「心態消極」。

cues.text: You can fall into this.
cues.en: You can fall into this.
cues.zh: 你也可能陷入這種狀態。 我母親晚年時的心態變得非常消極，

cues.text: My mother, in the last years of her life, became very negative, and it's hard to listen.
cues.en: My mother, in the last years of her life, became very negative, and it's hard to listen.
cues.zh: 我母親晚年時的心態變得非常消極， 沒有人願意聽她講話。 有一天我對她說：

cues.text: I remember one day, I said to her, "It's October 1 today," and she said, "I know, isn't it dreadful?"
cues.en: I remember one day, I said to her, "It's October 1 today," and she said, "I know, isn't it dreadful?"
cues.zh: 有一天我對她說： 「今天是10月1日了。」 她說：「是啊，很糟吧？」

cues.text: It's hard to listen when somebody's that negative.
cues.en: It's hard to listen when somebody's that negative.
cues.zh: （笑聲） 大家可不想聽那麼消極的人說話。

cues.text: And another form of negativity, complaining.
cues.en: And another form of negativity, complaining.
cues.zh: 抱怨也是一種負面情緒， 這已經成為了一種英國文化。

cues.text: Well, this is the national art of the U.K.
cues.en: Well, this is the national art of the U.K.
cues.zh: 這已經成為了一種英國文化。

cues.text: It's our national sport.
cues.en: It's our national sport.
cues.zh: 這已經成為了一種英國文化。 這是全民運動，我們抱怨天氣、

cues.text: We complain about the weather, sport, about politics, about everything, but actually, complaining is viral misery.
cues.en: We complain about the weather, sport, about politics, about everything, but actually, complaining is viral misery.
cues.zh: 這是全民運動，我們抱怨天氣、 抱怨比賽、抱怨政治，抱怨一切。 但抱怨是病毒般的災難。 因為你沒有把溫暖和光明帶給他人。

cues.text: It's not spreading sunshine and lightness in the world.
cues.en: It's not spreading sunshine and lightness in the world.
cues.zh: 因為你沒有把溫暖和光明帶給他人。

cues.text: Excuses.
cues.en: Excuses.
cues.zh: 因為你沒有把溫暖和光明帶給他人。 「找藉口」。我們都碰過這種人。

cues.text: We've all met this guy.
cues.en: We've all met this guy.
cues.zh: 「找藉口」。我們都碰過這種人。 也許我們都曾找藉口開脫。

cues.text: Maybe we've all been this guy.
cues.en: Maybe we've all been this guy.
cues.zh: 也許我們都曾找藉口開脫。 有些人老是找替死鬼，

cues.text: Some people have a blamethrower.
cues.en: Some people have a blamethrower.
cues.zh: 有些人老是找替死鬼，

cues.text: They just pass it on to everybody else and don't take responsibility for their actions,
cues.en: They just pass it on to everybody else and don't take responsibility for their actions,
cues.zh: 他們推諉塞責， 不為自己的言行承擔責任， 我們不太會去聽這種人說話。

cues.text: and again, hard to listen to somebody who is being like that.
cues.en: and again, hard to listen to somebody who is being like that.
cues.zh: 我們不太會去聽這種人說話。 倒數第二點，也就是第六點，

cues.text: Penultimate, the sixth of the seven, embroidery, exaggeration.
cues.en: Penultimate, the sixth of the seven, embroidery, exaggeration.
cues.zh: 倒數第二點，也就是第六點， 「花言巧語，過分誇張」。

cues.text: It demeans our language, actually, sometimes.
cues.en: It demeans our language, actually, sometimes.
cues.zh: 這可以說是對語言的褻瀆。

cues.text: For example, if I see something that really is awesome, what do I call it?
cues.en: For example, if I see something that really is awesome, what do I call it?
cues.zh: 假如一個說話誇張的人， 遇到超讚的事， 那麼他還能用什麼形容詞呢？

cues.text: And then, of course, this exaggeration becomes lying, and we don't want to listen to people we know are lying to us.
cues.en: And then, of course, this exaggeration becomes lying, and we don't want to listen to people we know are lying to us.
cues.zh: 其實，語言過分誇張就是欺騙， 不折不扣的謊言， 沒有人喜歡聽騙子的話。 最後是「過分武斷」。

cues.text: And finally, dogmatism.
cues.en: And finally, dogmatism.
cues.zh: 最後是「過分武斷」。

cues.text: The confusion of facts with opinions.
cues.en: The confusion of facts with opinions.
cues.zh: 真相與見解混淆不清。

cues.text: When those two things get conflated, you're listening into the wind.
cues.en: When those two things get conflated, you're listening into the wind.
cues.zh: 真相與見解混淆不清。 這樣講話只會成為別人的耳旁風。 就像有人用自以為是的觀點炮轟你，

cues.text: You know, somebody is bombarding you with their opinions as if they were true.
cues.en: You know, somebody is bombarding you with their opinions as if they were true.
cues.zh: 就像有人用自以為是的觀點炮轟你， 很難有人想聽他說話。

cues.text: It's difficult to listen to that.
cues.en: It's difficult to listen to that.
cues.zh: 很難有人想聽他說話。

cues.text: So here they are, seven deadly sins of speaking.
cues.en: So here they are, seven deadly sins of speaking.
cues.zh: 以上就是講話中的「七宗罪」。

cues.text: These are things I think we need to avoid.
cues.en: These are things I think we need to avoid.
cues.zh: 我們應該避免以上的錯誤。

cues.text: But is there a positive way to think about this?
cues.en: But is there a positive way to think about this?
cues.zh: 我們應該避免以上的錯誤。 那麼在講話時是否有能遵循的原則呢？

cues.text: Yes, there is.
cues.en: Yes, there is.
cues.zh: 是有幾項。

cues.text: I'd like to suggest that there are four really powerful cornerstones, foundations,
cues.en: I'd like to suggest that there are four really powerful cornerstones, foundations,
cues.zh: 我一共總結了四個 強而有力的基本要點， 能使我們講話更有影響力，

cues.text: that we can stand on if we want our speech to be powerful and to make change in the world.
cues.en: that we can stand on if we want our speech to be powerful and to make change in the world.
cues.zh: 能使我們講話更有影響力， 並且能夠改變這個世界。

cues.text: Fortunately, these things spell a word.
cues.en: Fortunately, these things spell a word.
cues.zh: 很湊巧，這四個要點可以拼成一個單詞，

cues.text: The word is "hail," and it has a great definition as well.
cues.en: The word is "hail," and it has a great definition as well.
cues.zh: 很湊巧，這四個要點可以拼成一個單詞， 這就是「HAIL」，這個單詞 本身就包含深刻的意義。

cues.text: I'm not talking about the stuff that falls from the sky and hits you on the head.
cues.en: I'm not talking about the stuff that falls from the sky and hits you on the head.
cues.zh: 我指的不是從天而下、 砸在你頭上的冰雹。 我指的是熱情歡呼、喝采的意思，

cues.text: I'm talking about this definition, to greet or acclaim enthusiastically, which is how I think our words will be received
cues.en: I'm talking about this definition, to greet or acclaim enthusiastically, which is how I think our words will be received
cues.zh: 我指的是熱情歡呼、喝采的意思， 若能依據這四個要點， 別人就能聽進我們的話。

cues.text: if we stand on these four things.
cues.en: if we stand on these four things.
cues.zh: 別人就能聽進我們的話。 那麼「HAIL」分別代表什麼呢？

cues.text: So what do they stand for?
cues.en: So what do they stand for?
cues.zh: 那麼「HAIL」分別代表什麼呢？

cues.text: See if you can guess.
cues.en: See if you can guess.
cues.zh: 你猜猜看。

cues.text: The H, honesty, of course, being true in what you say, being straight and clear.
cues.en: The H, honesty, of course, being true in what you say, being straight and clear.
cues.zh: 當然，「H」代表誠實 。 講話的內容要真實，且清晰無任何歪曲。

cues.text: The A is authenticity, just being yourself.
cues.en: The A is authenticity, just being yourself.
cues.zh: 講話的內容要真實，且清晰無任何歪曲。 「A」代表內心誠懇、 正心誠意（Authenticity）。

cues.text: A friend of mine described it as standing in your own truth, which I think is a lovely way to put it.
cues.en: A friend of mine described it as standing in your own truth, which I think is a lovely way to put it.
cues.zh: 「A」代表內心誠懇、 正心誠意（Authenticity）。 我朋友認為， 這就如同對自己誠實。 這個解釋非常到位。

cues.text: The I is integrity, being your word, actually doing what you say,
cues.en: The I is integrity, being your word, actually doing what you say,
cues.zh: 這個解釋非常到位。 「I」代表言行一致（Integrity）， 不能說一套做一套，

cues.text: and being somebody people can trust.
cues.en: and being somebody people can trust.
cues.zh: 做一個能讓人信任的人。

cues.text: And the L is love.
cues.en: And the L is love.
cues.zh: 「L」代表愛（Love），

cues.text: I don't mean romantic love, but I do mean wishing people well, for two reasons.
cues.en: I don't mean romantic love, but I do mean wishing people well, for two reasons.
cues.zh: 這不是指男女之間的愛情， 而是希望幫助別人、成就別人。 原因有二：首先，

cues.text: First of all, I think absolute honesty may not be what we want.
cues.en: First of all, I think absolute honesty may not be what we want.
cues.zh: 原因有二：首先， 我們也許不需要絕對的誠實。 「天哪，你今早真是難看」之類的話，

cues.text: I mean, my goodness, you look ugly this morning.
cues.en: I mean, my goodness, you look ugly this morning.
cues.zh: 「天哪，你今早真是難看」之類的話，

cues.text: Perhaps that's not necessary.
cues.en: Perhaps that's not necessary.
cues.zh: 「天哪，你今早真是難看」之類的話， 是沒有必要的。

cues.text: Tempered with love, of course, honesty is a great thing.
cues.en: Tempered with love, of course, honesty is a great thing.
cues.zh: 是沒有必要的。 如果你內心充滿慈愛， 那麼誠實就是很大的優點。

cues.text: But also, if you're really wishing somebody well, it's very hard to judge them at the same time.
cues.en: But also, if you're really wishing somebody well, it's very hard to judge them at the same time.
cues.zh: 如果你真心希望別人受益， 你就不會指摘別人的不是，

cues.text: I'm not even sure you can do those two things simultaneously.
cues.en: I'm not even sure you can do those two things simultaneously.
cues.zh: 你就不會指摘別人的不是， 因為你無法同時做到這兩件事。

cues.text: So hail.
cues.en: So hail.
cues.zh: 因為你無法同時做到這兩件事。 這就是「HAIL」。

cues.text: Also, now that's what you say, and it's like the old song, it is what you say,
cues.en: Also, now that's what you say, and it's like the old song, it is what you say,
cues.zh: 以上介紹的是講話的內容， 就像一首老歌裡唱的，你說的話重要， 你說話的方式也很重要。

cues.text: it's also the way that you say it.
cues.en: it's also the way that you say it.
cues.zh: 你說話的方式也很重要。 我們每個人都擁有智慧的寶庫，

cues.text: You have an amazing toolbox.
cues.en: You have an amazing toolbox.
cues.zh: 我們每個人都擁有智慧的寶庫，

cues.text: This instrument is incredible, and yet this is a toolbox that very few people have ever opened.
cues.en: This instrument is incredible, and yet this is a toolbox that very few people have ever opened.
cues.zh: 寶庫裡藏著十分有用的工具， 但很少有人開啟這座寶庫。

cues.text: I'd like to have a little rummage in there with you now and just pull a few tools out
cues.en: I'd like to have a little rummage in there with you now and just pull a few tools out
cues.zh: 接下來我將與各位一起進入寶庫探索， 尋找一些大家都樂於使用的工具，

cues.text: that you might like to take away and play with, which will increase the power of your speaking.
cues.en: that you might like to take away and play with, which will increase the power of your speaking.
cues.zh: 尋找一些大家都樂於使用的工具， 就能藉此增強你說話的力量。 首先是音區。

cues.text: Register, for example.
cues.en: Register, for example.
cues.zh: 首先是音區。

cues.text: Now, falsetto register may not be very useful most of the time,
cues.en: Now, falsetto register may not be very useful most of the time,
cues.zh: 在講話時，假音往往不太有效，

cues.text: but there's a register in between.
cues.en: but there's a register in between.
cues.zh: 因此我們應當使用較為適中的聲區。

cues.text: I'm not going to get very technical about this for any of you who are voice coaches.
cues.en: I'm not going to get very technical about this for any of you who are voice coaches.
cues.zh: 因此我們應當使用較為適中的聲區。 我不想說得太專業，以免班門弄斧， 因為在座有很多是聲樂導師。 其實，我們可以自己調整發聲位置。

cues.text: You can locate your voice, however.
cues.en: You can locate your voice, however.
cues.zh: 其實，我們可以自己調整發聲位置。 如果我透過鼻腔發聲，你就會聽出不同；

cues.text: So if I talk up here in my nose, you can hear the difference.
cues.en: So if I talk up here in my nose, you can hear the difference.
cues.zh: 如果我透過鼻腔發聲，你就會聽出不同； 透過喉嚨發聲是這樣的，

cues.text: If I go down here in my throat, which is where most of us speak from most of the time.
cues.en: If I go down here in my throat, which is where most of us speak from most of the time.
cues.zh: 透過喉嚨發聲是這樣的， 在座大多數人通常都透過喉嚨發聲。 但如果你想加強聲音的厚重感，

cues.text: But if you want weight, you need to go down here to the chest.
cues.en: But if you want weight, you need to go down here to the chest.
cues.zh: 但如果你想加強聲音的厚重感， 就可以透過胸腔發聲。

cues.text: You hear the difference?
cues.en: You hear the difference?
cues.zh: 你能聽出區別嗎？

cues.text: We vote for politicians with lower voices, it's true,
cues.en: We vote for politicians with lower voices, it's true,
cues.zh: 我們會把票投給嗓音低沉的候選人， 這是真的，因為低沉的嗓音

cues.text: because we associate depth with power and with authority.
cues.en: because we associate depth with power and with authority.
cues.zh: 這是真的，因為低沉的嗓音 會讓人們想到力量和權威。

cues.text: That's register.
cues.en: That's register.
cues.zh: 會讓人們想到力量和權威。 這是「聲區」。

cues.text: Then we have timbre.
cues.en: Then we have timbre.
cues.zh: 這是「聲區」。 下面我們介紹「音色」，

cues.text: It's the way your voice feels.
cues.en: It's the way your voice feels.
cues.zh: 下面我們介紹「音色」， 也就是嗓音帶給別人的感覺。

cues.text: Again, the research shows that we prefer voices which are rich, smooth, warm,
cues.en: Again, the research shows that we prefer voices which are rich, smooth, warm,
cues.zh: 研究顯示，我們偏好 如同熱巧克力一般 豐富、流暢、溫暖的嗓音。

cues.text: like hot chocolate.
cues.en: like hot chocolate.
cues.zh: 如同熱巧克力一般 豐富、流暢、溫暖的嗓音。

cues.text: Well if that's not you, that's not the end of the world, because you can train.
cues.en: Well if that's not you, that's not the end of the world, because you can train.
cues.zh: 如同熱巧克力一般 豐富、流暢、溫暖的嗓音。 你沒有這種嗓音也不要緊， 可以透過訓練改變，

cues.text: Go and get a voice coach.
cues.en: Go and get a voice coach.
cues.zh: 可以尋求聲樂導師的幫助。

cues.text: And there are amazing things you can do with breathing, with posture, and with exercises
cues.en: And there are amazing things you can do with breathing, with posture, and with exercises
cues.zh: 你也可以在很多方面下功夫， 比如呼吸、姿勢以及勤奮的練習，

cues.text: to improve the timbre of your voice.
cues.en: to improve the timbre of your voice.
cues.zh: 比如呼吸、姿勢以及勤奮的練習， 這樣你就能改善自己的音色。

cues.text: Then prosody. I love prosody.
cues.en: Then prosody. I love prosody.
cues.zh: 第三是注意「抑揚頓挫」。

cues.text: This is the sing-song, the meta-language that we use in order to impart meaning.
cues.en: This is the sing-song, the meta-language that we use in order to impart meaning.
cues.zh: 這就好比是歌唱， 它能使語意層次分明，

cues.text: It's root one for meaning in conversation.
cues.en: It's root one for meaning in conversation.
cues.zh: 這是談話中表達意義的根本。

cues.text: People who speak all on one note are really quite hard to listen to
cues.en: People who speak all on one note are really quite hard to listen to
cues.zh: 這是談話中表達意義的根本。 單一的語調 很不利於他人聆聽。

cues.text: if they don't have any prosody at all.
cues.en: if they don't have any prosody at all.
cues.zh: 很不利於他人聆聽。 缺乏抑揚頓挫就不會收到理想效果，

cues.text: That's where the word "monotonic" comes from, or monotonous, monotone.
cues.en: That's where the word "monotonic" comes from, or monotonous, monotone.
cues.zh: 缺乏抑揚頓挫就不會收到理想效果， 這會讓世界變得 平淡而單調。

cues.text: Also, we have repetitive prosody now coming in, where every sentence ends as if it were a question
cues.en: Also, we have repetitive prosody now coming in, where every sentence ends as if it were a question
cues.zh: 但也不要頻繁而重複地使用語調， 不要在每句話的結尾使用升調， 讓人誤以為是疑問句，

cues.text: when it's actually not a question, it's a statement?
cues.en: when it's actually not a question, it's a statement?
cues.zh: 不要在每句話的結尾使用升調， 讓人誤以為是疑問句， 其實那隻不過是陳述句而已。 （笑聲）

cues.text: And if you repeat that one, it's actually restricting your ability to communicate through prosody,
cues.en: And if you repeat that one, it's actually restricting your ability to communicate through prosody,
cues.zh: （笑聲） 重複地使用語調 會侷限原本該有的溝通效果， 那就可惜了，

cues.text: which I think is a shame, so let's try and break that habit.
cues.en: which I think is a shame, so let's try and break that habit.
cues.zh: 那就可惜了， 所以我們要改掉這種習慣。

cues.text: Pace.
cues.en: Pace.
cues.zh: 「語速」。我能表現得非常興奮，

cues.text: I can get very excited by saying something really quickly, or I can slow right down to emphasize,
cues.en: I can get very excited by saying something really quickly, or I can slow right down to emphasize,
cues.zh: 「語速」。我能表現得非常興奮， 只要用極快的語速講話； 也可以放慢語速，就能有強調的效果。

cues.text: and at the end of that, of course, is our old friend silence.
cues.en: and at the end of that, of course, is our old friend silence.
cues.zh: 接下來，我要介紹經典的一招： 「沉默」。

cues.text: There's nothing wrong with a bit of silence in a talk, is there?
cues.en: There's nothing wrong with a bit of silence in a talk, is there?
cues.zh: 在講話中適時地沉默片刻 並無不可，對吧？

cues.text: We don't have to fill it with ums and ahs.
cues.en: We don't have to fill it with ums and ahs.
cues.zh: 並無不可，對吧？ 為什麼要使用無謂的「嗯」和「啊」呢？

cues.text: It can be very powerful.
cues.en: It can be very powerful.
cues.zh: 沉默才更有力量。

cues.text: Of course, pitch often goes along with pace to indicate arousal, but you can do it just with pitch.
cues.en: Of course, pitch often goes along with pace to indicate arousal, but you can do it just with pitch.
cues.zh: 沉默才更有力量。 並用「音高」與「語速」時， 往往能喚起聽者的注意， 只有音高也有效。 你把我的鑰匙放在哪兒了？

cues.text: Where did you leave my keys?
cues.en: Where did you leave my keys?
cues.zh: 你把我的鑰匙放在哪兒了？

cues.text: leave my keys?
cues.en: leave my keys?
cues.zh: 你把我的鑰匙放在哪兒了？ 這兩句話的意思

cues.text: So, slightly different meaning in those two deliveries.
cues.en: So, slightly different meaning in those two deliveries.
cues.zh: 這兩句話的意思 是略有不同的。

cues.text: And finally, volume.
cues.en: And finally, volume.
cues.zh: 最後是「音量」。

cues.text: I can get really excited by using volume.
cues.en: I can get really excited by using volume.
cues.zh: 最後是「音量」。 這樣大的音量讓我顯得非常興奮，

cues.text: Sorry about that, if I startled anybody.
cues.en: Sorry about that, if I startled anybody.
cues.zh: 這樣大的音量讓我顯得非常興奮， 非常抱歉嚇了你們一跳。

cues.text: Or, I can have you really pay attention by getting very quiet.
cues.en: Or, I can have you really pay attention by getting very quiet.
cues.zh: 我也可以把聲音放輕， 吸引你們的注意力。

cues.text: Some people broadcast the whole time.
cues.en: Some people broadcast the whole time.
cues.zh: 有些人總是聲大如雷， 請不要這樣，

cues.text: Try not to do that.
cues.en: Try not to do that.
cues.zh: 請不要這樣，

cues.text: That's called sodcasting, Imposing your sound on people around you carelessly and inconsiderately.
cues.en: That's called sodcasting, Imposing your sound on people around you carelessly and inconsiderately.
cues.zh: 這就像在公共場所用手機放音樂， 漫不經心地強迫他人聽你的音樂， 這不太好。

cues.text: Not nice.
cues.en: Not nice.
cues.zh: 這不太好。 當然，這些方法要起作用

cues.text: Of course, where this all comes into play most of all is when you've got something really important to do.
cues.en: Of course, where this all comes into play most of all is when you've got something really important to do.
cues.zh: 當然，這些方法要起作用 得要是你做重要的事才行。 比如像現在這樣站在舞臺上

cues.text: It might be standing on a stage like this and giving a talk to people.
cues.en: It might be standing on a stage like this and giving a talk to people.
cues.zh: 比如像現在這樣站在舞臺上 對大家演講， 也可能是求婚、請求加薪，

cues.text: It might be proposing marriage, asking for a raise, a wedding speech.
cues.en: It might be proposing marriage, asking for a raise, a wedding speech.
cues.zh: 也可能是求婚、請求加薪， 或者在婚禮上致賀詞等等，

cues.text: Whatever it is, if it's really important, you owe it to yourself to look at this toolbox
cues.en: Whatever it is, if it's really important, you owe it to yourself to look at this toolbox
cues.zh: 或者在婚禮上致賀詞等等， 這些都屬於重要場合。 大家有必要看看 這個能夠派上用場的寶庫和引擎。

cues.text: and the engine that it's going to work on, and no engine works well without being warmed up.
cues.en: and the engine that it's going to work on, and no engine works well without being warmed up.
cues.zh: 這個能夠派上用場的寶庫和引擎。 但機器工作前都需要預熱， 否則就不能發揮效能。

cues.text: Warm up your voice.
cues.en: Warm up your voice.
cues.zh: 但機器工作前都需要預熱， 否則就不能發揮效能。 聲音也需要熱身。

cues.text: Actually, let me show you how to do that.
cues.en: Actually, let me show you how to do that.
cues.zh: 聲音也需要熱身。 我來示範如何為嗓子做體操。 大家能夠站起來嗎？不會耽誤很久。

cues.text: Would you all like to stand up for a moment?
cues.en: Would you all like to stand up for a moment?
cues.zh: 大家能夠站起來嗎？不會耽誤很久。

cues.text: I'm going to show you the six vocal warm-up exercises that I do before every talk I ever do.
cues.en: I'm going to show you the six vocal warm-up exercises that I do before every talk I ever do.
cues.zh: 我將示範口腔體操「六部曲」。 每次演說前我都會這麼做。

cues.text: Any time you're going to talk to anybody important, do these.
cues.en: Any time you're going to talk to anybody important, do these.
cues.zh: 如果你要和別人談重要的事情， 就做以下練習： 首先舉起雙手，深呼吸。

cues.text: First, arms up, deep breath in, and sigh out, ahhhhh, like that.
cues.en: First, arms up, deep breath in, and sigh out, ahhhhh, like that.
cues.zh: 首先舉起雙手，深呼吸。 然後吐氣，「呵……」就像這樣。

cues.text: One more time.
cues.en: One more time.
cues.zh: 然後吐氣，「呵……」就像這樣。 再來一次。

cues.text: Ahhhh, very good.
cues.en: Ahhhh, very good.
cues.zh: 再來一次。 「呵……」，非常好。

cues.text: Now we're going to warm up our lips, and we're going to go Ba,
cues.en: Now we're going to warm up our lips, and we're going to go Ba,
cues.zh: 現在要鍛煉嘴唇了。 像這樣「啵、啵、啵、啵」，

cues.text: Ba, Ba. Very good.
cues.en: Ba, Ba. Very good.
cues.zh: 像這樣「啵、啵、啵、啵」， 「啵、啵、啵、啵」，非常好。

cues.text: And now, brrrrrrrrrr, just like when you were a kid.
cues.en: And now, brrrrrrrrrr, just like when you were a kid.
cues.zh: 現在是「噗……」， 就像個小孩子一樣， 「噗……」，你的嘴唇就會靈活了。

cues.text: Brrrr. Now your lips should be coming alive.
cues.en: Brrrr. Now your lips should be coming alive.
cues.zh: 「噗……」，你的嘴唇就會靈活了。

cues.text: We're going to do the tongue next with exaggerated la, la.
cues.en: We're going to do the tongue next with exaggerated la, la.
cues.zh: 「噗……」，你的嘴唇就會靈活了。 現在是舌尖上的體操。 用誇張的嘴型說「啦、啦、啦、啦」，

cues.text: Beautiful. You're getting really good at this.
cues.en: Beautiful. You're getting really good at this.
cues.zh: 大家都做得非常好。 現在是捲舌的「日…日…日…」，

cues.text: And then, roll an R. Rrrrrrr.
cues.en: And then, roll an R. Rrrrrrr.
cues.zh: 現在是捲舌的「日…日…日…」，

cues.text: That's like champagne for the tongue.
cues.en: That's like champagne for the tongue.
cues.zh: 這是舌尖上的華爾滋。

cues.text: Finally, and if I can only do one, the pros call this the siren.
cues.en: Finally, and if I can only do one, the pros call this the siren.
cues.zh: 這是舌尖上的華爾滋。 最後一個練習，「六部曲」的壓軸戲， 專家們稱之為「誘人的歌聲」。

cues.text: It's really good. It starts with "we" and goes to "aw." The "we" is high, the "aw" is low.
cues.en: It's really good. It starts with "we" and goes to "aw." The "we" is high, the "aw" is low.
cues.zh: 這是非常精彩的體操。 從「嗚伊」開始進入「噢」， 「嗚伊」是高音，「噢」是低音。 我們開始「嗚伊…噢…嗚伊…噢…」，

cues.text: So you go, weeeaawww, weeeaawww.
cues.en: So you go, weeeaawww, weeeaawww.
cues.zh: 我們開始「嗚伊…噢…嗚伊…噢…」，

cues.text: Fantastic. Give yourselves a round of applause.
cues.en: Fantastic. Give yourselves a round of applause.
cues.zh: 非常棒。請給自己一些掌聲吧。 請坐，謝謝各位。（掌聲）

cues.text: Take a seat, thank you.
cues.en: Take a seat, thank you.
cues.zh: 請坐，謝謝各位。（掌聲）

cues.text: Next time you speak, do those in advance.
cues.en: Next time you speak, do those in advance.
cues.zh: 請坐，謝謝各位。（掌聲） 下次在您講話前別忘了先做口腔體操。

cues.text: Now let me just put this in context to close.
cues.en: Now let me just put this in context to close.
cues.zh: 讓我回到主題來做個總結，

cues.text: This is a serious point here.
cues.en: This is a serious point here.
cues.zh: 我們提出了一個重要的主題。

cues.text: This is where we are now, right?
cues.en: This is where we are now, right?
cues.zh: 我們提出了一個重要的主題。 我們現在是這樣吧？

cues.text: We speak not very well to people who simply aren't listening
cues.en: We speak not very well to people who simply aren't listening
cues.zh: 我們現在是這樣吧？ 我們講的話， 讓別人聽不進去。 這不是由於噪音、 聲學環境不佳所造成的。

cues.text: in an environment that's all about noise and bad acoustics.
cues.en: in an environment that's all about noise and bad acoustics.
cues.zh: 這不是由於噪音、 聲學環境不佳所造成的。 我在演講的過程中

cues.en: I have talked about that on this stage in different phases.

cues.text: What would the world be like if we were speaking powerfully to people who were listening consciously
cues.en: What would the world be like if we were speaking powerfully to people who were listening consciously
cues.zh: 如果我們講的話影響力強大， 讓別人樂於傾聽， 而且各種外在條件也適合我們講話，

cues.text: in environments which were actually fit for purpose?
cues.en: in environments which were actually fit for purpose?
cues.zh: 而且各種外在條件也適合我們講話， 那麼世界將會如何？

cues.text: Or to make that a bit larger, what would the world be like
cues.en: Or to make that a bit larger, what would the world be like
cues.zh: 那麼世界將會如何？ 如果擴大範圍來講， 如果我們有意識地發出聲音、 有意識地接受聲音，

cues.text: if we were creating sound consciously and consuming sound consciously
cues.en: if we were creating sound consciously and consuming sound consciously
cues.zh: 有意識地接受聲音， 並且很好地設定

cues.en: and designing all our environments consciously for sound?

cues.en: That would be a world that does sound beautiful, and one where understanding would be the norm,
cues.zh: 這個世界將處處洋溢著美好的音符。 在這個世界中， 相互理解就是標準和規範。

cues.text: and that is an idea worth spreading.
cues.en: and that is an idea worth spreading.
